title: Learning to segment facade cracks
abstract: This synthetic example connects image segmentation, building inspection and UAV imagery. It illustrates how pixel-level masks and domain knowledge can support the interpretation of visible facade cracks. The record is created only to demonstrate Paperloom's interface.
note: 重点对照：分割模型如何对应到实际缺陷类别。演示笔记，不代表研究结论。

title: Vision-language models for building inspection
abstract: A synthetic demonstration of combining image segmentation and vision language models for building defect inspection. Domain knowledge helps compare visual evidence and textual descriptions. This is an illustrative record, not a published study.

title: UAV imagery for structural condition assessment
abstract: This illustrative record concerns UAV imagery, crack segmentation and building inspection. It is included to show a related methods branch in the graph. The synthetic document does not report empirical results.

title: Mapping urban heat with satellite observations
abstract: An illustrative record connecting satellite imagery, urban heat and heat exposure. It relates environmental measurements to human mobility and urban vegetation. The document is synthetic and contains no research findings.

title: Tree cover and neighborhood cooling
abstract: This synthetic record uses urban vegetation, green infrastructure and satellite imagery to illustrate a connection between urban cooling and environmental observation. It is a demonstration document rather than a published paper.

title: Human mobility and outdoor heat exposure
abstract: An illustrative record about human mobility, urban heat and heat exposure. Satellite imagery and environmental observations provide related concepts for exploring cross-category links. No measurements or findings are claimed.

title: Satellite time series for urban vegetation
abstract: A synthetic example of satellite imagery and green infrastructure mapping. It connects the observation of urban vegetation with urban cooling questions. This record is designed for a software demonstration.

title: Protein sequence alignment for structure prediction
abstract: A synthetic example concerning protein sequence alignment and structure prediction. It has no intended relationship to the building inspection or urban environment examples and should remain an isolated node.
